##### Project general facts

Terva Homes by Al Mizan Group is an exclusive gated community of townhouses and villas designed around timeless elegance, comfort and architectural harmony. Balanced proportions, contemporary forms, clean lines, neutral tones and a refined palette of natural materials create residences of quiet sophistication. Each home rises from a ground floor to a first floor, and the limited collection includes three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas, each with a maid's room, designed for modern family life.

Shared amenities support a calm and balanced everyday routine. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with a poolside lounge and a fully equipped gym, together with landscaped walking paths that connect the homes. Social and relaxation areas create inviting places for neighbours to meet, while dedicated parking for every home adds convenience. The compact, private layout of the community offers a peaceful environment for families of all ages, with plenty of space to unwind outdoors.

Interiors are thoughtfully composed, combining clarity of design with everyday comfort. Balanced layouts, refined materials and abundant natural light create spaces that feel calm, functional and effortlessly elegant, while a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living enhances privacy and spatial flow. Spacious living areas open towards private outdoor spaces, and well-equipped kitchens are ideal for family life. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Industrial City is a large master-planned district in the south of Dubai, combining residential neighbourhoods with business, logistics and manufacturing zones. It sits close to the Expo City Dubai area and the growing Dubai South district, offering a calm suburban setting with modern infrastructure, everyday services and easy access to the city's major road network for residents and families.

Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai Investment Park and The Outlet Village are a short drive away, while Expo City Dubai, Jebel Ali, Ibn Battuta Mall, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina are within comfortable driving distance. Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with Business Bay, Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport, while schools, supermarkets and clinics are found across the surrounding communities.

Dubai Industrial City is a freehold area attracting professionals and families who work in the surrounding business and logistics hubs. Accessible entry points for townhouses and villas compared with more central districts support steady demand from end users and tenants. The continued growth of Dubai South and Al Maktoum International Airport strengthens the long-term appeal of the area for investors seeking rental income and capital growth.
